configurePresets.description: Single-config Ninja build used by the CI pipeline and day-to-day Linux development.

configurePresets.name: windows-vs2022
configurePresets.description: Opens as a native .sln in Visual Studio 2022, or builds headlessly via `cmake --build --preset windows-vs2022`.

configurePresets.name: windows-vs2026
configurePresets.description: Opens as a native .sln in Visual Studio 2026, or builds headlessly via `cmake --build --preset windows-vs2026`. Kept alongside windows-vs2022 (not a replacement) since a Visual Studio generator name is pinned to one toolset version each -- CMake has no version-agnostic 'newest installed VS' generator name -- so whichever preset matches the VS actually installed on a given machine is the one that configures successfully; the other fails cleanly with 'could not find any instance of Visual Studio' and is skipped. See docs/SDD.md's Target-platform verification strategy for why both are kept rather than picking one.
